# Pixel Library Desk

A simple offline browser app that simulates a library desk with 6 built-in books.

## Features

- List of 6 books with title, author, and availability status.
- Check out or return a book with a single button click.
- Filter to show only available books.
- Live count of checked-out books.
- Fully keyboard accessible and responsive down to 360px.

## Usage

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. No server or internet connection required.

## Files

- `index.html` – main page structure
- `styles.css` – visual design and responsive layout
- `script.js` – book data and interactive logic

## Accessibility

- All buttons have clear labels and use `addEventListener`.
- Focus states are visible.
- The checked-out count uses `aria-live` for screen readers.
